solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Supporter providing government intelligence

parts.note: a bra is a supporting undergarment
a party providing government is in power

explanation.surface: A political backer offers the government some secret information.
explanation.definitionFit: Brainpower is mental capacity, a synonym for intelligence in the sense of cleverness.

clue.text: Dish, very dry, should be dipped in port

indicators.note: the very-dry letters go inside the port's name

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port
so means very
TT, teetotal, means not drinking, dry

explanation.surface: A very dry dish needs dunking in a glass of port wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' looks like the wine but is the harbour city RIO.
explanation.definitionFit: This Italian rice preparation is a dish cooked in stock.

clue.text: Shakespearean ensign holding male, idealised view

indicators.note: the ensign's name contains the letter for male

parts.note: Iago is Othello's ensign in Shakespeare

explanation.surface: Iago, keeping hold of a man, has a romantic picture of him.
explanation.definitionFit: In psychoanalysis the term is an idealised mental image of someone, such as a parent.

clue.text: Actor filled with zest as theatre fan

indicators.note: the actor word has the zest word put inside it

parts.note: a player is an actor
go means energy or zest

explanation.surface: An actor full of enthusiasm is a lover of the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who regularly attends the theatre is a fan of plays.

clue.text: Why's PA notorious when sloshed? That's question of choice

indicators.note: sloshed means drunk, so the letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks why a personal assistant is so infamous when drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom is a barman's or host's way of asking what drink you would choose.

clue.text: Sheep indeed upended 1966 winner

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep

indicators.note: in a down clue the word for indeed is turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: yes means indeed

explanation.surface: A sheep, indeed, flipped over the 1966 champion.
explanation.walkthrough: Alf Ramsey managed England to the 1966 football World Cup win.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Alf managed England's World Cup-winning side in 1966.

clue.text: Rhythm and echo in club

indicators.note: the letter for echo sits in the word for club, placed within it

parts.note: a bat is a club used in sport
Echo is E in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Music in a nightclub has rhythm and reverberation.
explanation.definitionFit: A beat is the regular pulse in music, which is its rhythm.

clue.text: Do listen to a much-loved singer

parts.note: a do is a party, such as a ball

indicators.note: what is heard of the phrase is used, not its spelling

parts.note: a much-loved person is a dear

explanation.surface: Pay attention to a well-loved singer.
explanation.definitionFit: A balladeer sings ballads, so is a type of singer.

clue.text: Records are cut with knife

indicators.note: the word are is split open by the knife word

parts.note: chiv is slang for a knife

explanation.surface: Records are slashed with a blade.
explanation.definitionFit: Archives are collections of historical records; the plural noun is used here as a singular collective.

clue.text: Large region in Matsuida regularly ignored

indicators.note: every other letter of the made-up name is skipped, keeping the rest

explanation.surface: Someone called Matsuida apparently overlooks a big area.
explanation.walkthrough: Drop M, T, U and D, the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of Matsuida, and the even letters remain.
explanation.definitionFit: The continent is the world's largest land region.

clue.text: Anxiety about hair that will interrupt sleep

parts.note: alarm is fear or anxiety
C, for circa, means about
a lock is a tress of hair

explanation.surface: Worry about one's hair keeps a person awake at night.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedside device that rings at a set time exists precisely to wake the sleeper.

clue.text: Saint and unethical wife going deep

indicators.note: the wife departs, leaving the word for unethical without her letter

parts.note: unethical conduct is wrong

explanation.surface: A saint and a wicked wife are getting into deep matters.
explanation.definitionFit: A strong colour or feeling is a deep one, so the two adjectives are synonyms in that sense.

clue.text: Film story in a score rewritten

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are written out again in a new order

explanation.surface: A film plot appears in a musical score that has been revised.
explanation.definitionFit: A screenplay outline giving the plot of a film is called by that name.

clue.text: Melancholy men reversed in top gear

parts.note: sombre means gloomy or melancholy

indicators.note: the abbreviation for men is turned back to front

parts.note: OR, other ranks, is crossword shorthand for soldiers who are not officers, i.e. men

explanation.surface: Gloomy men in the best equipment, or on a TV motoring show, go backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: Top Gear is a British TV motoring show, but here 'top gear' means headwear.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide-brimmed Mexican hat is worn on the head, gear for the top of you.

clue.text: Clan wars, for Spooner, overwhelm Cornish resort

indicators.note: Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the starts of the two words are exchanged

parts.note: to flood is to overwhelm
Bude is a seaside resort in Cornwall, England

explanation.surface: Clan wars flood a Cornish seaside town.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-running vendetta between families or clans is warfare of this kind.

clue.text: First couple to disappear in country garden

indicators.note: the opening two letters of the country are removed

parts.note: Sweden is a Scandinavian country

explanation.surface: Adam and Eve vanish into a rural garden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First couple' looks like Adam and Eve, which suits the garden, but it means the first two letters, SW.
explanation.definitionFit: The Garden of Eden is the biblical paradise garden.

clue.text: Second bed delivered without damage

parts.note: a cot is a bed
delivered from captivity means freed, free

explanation.surface: A second bed arrives undamaged.
explanation.definitionFit: To get off unpunished or unharmed is the sense of the compound adjective.

clue.text: Edible plant given in measured dose

indicators.note: the letters are supplied inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A food plant is administered in a careful dose.
explanation.walkthrough: The four letters run from measurED DOse.
explanation.definitionFit: The taro is a tropical plant with an edible starchy root, also known by this name.

clue.text: Capone with posh character upset one with an interest in 14?

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the string upside down, so it reads backwards

parts.note: Al Capone was a Chicago gangster
U means upper-class, posh
a card is an eccentric character

explanation.surface: Al Capone and a toff upset a fellow fond of clan feuding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses ALUCARD. The 14 cross-reference points to BLOOD FEUD, but only its first word, blood, matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoker's vampire count drinks human blood, so has an interest in it.

clue.text: Excessive demand nasty letter communicates?

parts.note: a letter here is a landlord, someone who lets property; a nasty one demands an extortionate charge for the tenancy

explanation.surface: A hostile written message makes an unreasonable demand.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Letter' looks like a written message but means one who lets property.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names an extortionate rent, close to the full value of the property, exacted by a grasping landlord.

clue.text: Capital one invested in corrupt casino

indicators.note: the letter for one is put inside the jumbled word
corrupted letters are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Money is put into a crooked casino.
explanation.walkthrough: 'corrupt' rearranges CASINO into NICOSA, and 'invested in' puts I inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the capital city of Cyprus.

clue.text: Fried bananas, about five heated

indicators.note: the scrambled letters go round the numeral
bananas means crazy, so the letters are mixed up

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five

explanation.surface: Fried bananas with five of them, all hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bananas' rearranges FRIED into FERID, which goes 'about' V.
explanation.definitionFit: Fervid means intensely passionate, or hot in an emotional sense.

clue.text: Drunken sea-dog in coastal location

indicators.note: a drunk staggers about, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An inebriated old sailor ends up at the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Californian city lies on the Pacific coast, a place by the sea.

clue.text: Vehicle going back into the ancient land

indicators.note: the turned-round vehicle is placed within the word the
the vehicle's letters run backwards

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A car reverses into an old country.
explanation.definitionFit: This was an ancient region in the Balkans, north of the Aegean.

clue.text: Sacred flower for Richardson perhaps?

parts.note: in crosswords a flower is something that flows, a river, abbreviated R
Alph is the sacred river in Coleridge's poem Kubla Khan

explanation.surface: A holy bloom is intended for someone named Richardson.
explanation.walkthrough: Together the two words give R. ALPH, the River Alph of Kubla Khan.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Ralph Richardson was a celebrated English actor, so that is an example of the first name.

clue.text: Excellent shield one looks over

parts.note: super means excellent
a visor shields the eyes or face

explanation.surface: A fine protective screen is something you peer over.
explanation.definitionFit: An overseer watches over the work of others, so one who oversees is a manager.

clue.text: Cat in wood by lake

parts.note: ash is a timber

explanation.surface: A cat is up a tree near a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cat' is the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip, not a feline.
explanation.definitionFit: The cat-o'-nine-tails is a whip, and a stroke with one is a stroke of the whip.

clue.text: Poor to welcome Liberal found wanting in Barnet?

indicators.note: the word for poor takes the Liberal in, enclosing it

parts.note: bad means of low quality, poor

explanation.surface: A poor town welcomes a Liberal but is found lacking in Barnet, the London borough.
explanation.walkthrough: Barnet is also British rhyming slang for hair (Barnet Fair), as well as a London borough.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone lacking hair on the head is hairless, which is the sense of the adjective.

clue.text: Idiot daughter working for boss

parts.note: someone working for a boss works under them
the head is the boss

explanation.surface: A foolish daughter is employed by the boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A blockhead or dunce is a stupid person, a synonym for idiot.
